_what: One table of composed-candidate cards and what each one's placement is, read by the composer (`compose.placement_standing`, which `compose.rank_key` ranks on) and by the workbench (`candidateStanding.js::standingOf`, which the Candidate Set's strip and Next read). `refused` is null on a card for three different reasons and only one of them is a pass, and the two readers are in two languages, so neither can import the other; this file is what keeps them one reading. A case is a card as the server serves it, trimmed to the fields either reader looks at. The stop_reason string is `revise.STOP_PLACEMENT_UNJUDGED` and a test in each language holds its own copy to it.
_not_here: A card that is not an object at all is handled by each reader's guard and is driven in each language. The kinds a refusal may carry are `typefacts.REFUSAL_KINDS`; `sheet/refusal.js::REFUSAL_KINDS` and `workbench/server/rail.py` hold their own copies, and a test in each language holds the copy to the source.

cases.name: a placed loop that refused the placement, infeasible

lines: the declared facts cannot all hold

cases.name: a placed loop that refused the placement, a type fact downgraded

lines: a declared stack is drawn clear of the room it names

cases.name: a refusal is read whether or not the loop's report came with it
the placed loop ran, returned a placement, and did not refuse it

a compose that ran without the loop
a candidate the set's revise budget never reached

card.revision_skipped: the set's revise budget was spent on the candidates ranked above

cases.name: the declared first pass carries neither field
a loop whose first placement could not be evaluated judged nothing
a refusal wrapped as the 422 detail carries it is read as the refusal it wraps
a kind with stray whitespace is the kind
a refusal of a kind nobody here mints is a verdict nobody can read: unjudged, not refused and not placed
a refusal that is a string is unreadable
a refusal that is a list is unreadable
a refusal that is an empty object is unreadable, and is not a pass
a refusal that is false is present and is not a pass
